 Summary
 England leading Spain in Madrid in final Nations League group game
 Kane , Konsa and White had put Three Lions 3-0 up in remarkable first hour
 Williams and Oyarzabal have given hosts hope after Anderson sent off
 England have already qualified for quarter-finals in March
 Close form Send us your views

 Spain 2-3 England 
 It's heart in mouth stuff for England.
 Nico Williams sends the ball in and Jarell Quansah just does enough to ensure the ball goes behind for a goal-kick and not a corner.

 Spain 2-3 England 
 The chances are coming thick and fast now and the crowd are right behind Spain.
 A heck of an atmosphere inside the Metropolitano and England have got just over 10 minutes to hold onto their now very slim advantage.

 Post published at 21:28 GMT 21:28 GMT 
 Spain 2-3 England 
 Matt Upson 
Ex-England defender on BBC Radio 5 Live in Madrid 
 Question marks starting to appear on how England are going to manage the game. Anthony Gordon just holds onto the ball a moment too long. This is big trouble for England here. 
 302 364 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 78 mins 78 mins 
 Spain 2-3 England 
 Mistakes have proved costly for England in this second half.
 Thomas Tuchel makes his first change of the night and it's Myles Lewis-Skelly for...Harry Kane.
 403 851 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Spain 2-3 England 
 Lamine Yamal has been directly involved in 11 goals in his last 10 home games for Spain, scoring six and assisting five.
 It was that Euro 2024-winning combination of Yamal and Nico Willianms combining for the goal.
 239 529 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Spain 2-3 England 
 And still no changes from Thomas Tuchel.
 210 506 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Spain 2-3 England published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 Nico Williams (75 mins) 
 All of a sudden, the tables have turned.
 Anthony Gordon loses the ball in a dangerous area and Spain swarm forward.
 The ball from Lamine Yamal on the right-hand side is on a plate for Nico Williams and he finishes off one post and into the other corner.
 Now it's really game on.
 1323 4171 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 74 mins 74 mins 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 A goalmouth scramble as the ball comes in and Fermín Lopez gets the shot away.
 James Trafford makes a brilliant reaction save in a packed penalty box.
 1021 179 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 73 mins 73 mins 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Jarell Quansah turns the ball behind for a corner before Ezri Konsa has to do the same again.
 289 93 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Matt Upson 
Ex-England defender on BBC Radio 5 Live in Madrid 
 I love the fact the team went into a huddle and if anything the manager's stepped back because he wants to see the player reaction.
 You feel this next five minutes is crucial. 
 627 116 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 72 mins 72 mins 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Nico Williams replaces Martin Zubimendi.
 Thomas Tuchel yet to make any changes after that red card.
 194 96 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 71 mins 71 mins 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Lots of you saying it was a foul from Lamine Yamal on Jarell Quansah before Elliot Anderson's foul.
 The whole incident was clumsy with the pass back to Quansah from Declan Rice also a bit daft.
 693 213 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Click 'get involved' to send us your views 
 Why pull Yamal back?! Naive. Instead of being 1-3 11v11 we’re now 1-3 and a man down. We were 3 goals up, and he didn’t give Trafford a chance to make the save.
 Matthew Taylor 
 Red card is harsh Anderson touches his shoulder definitely a penalty though. Spain are going to use all the dark arts dirty tactics now.
 Jay 
 1114 404 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 69 mins 69 mins 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Before that goal I was going to say that James Trafford had not had a single save to make. Spain had not had a shot on target.
 They have now had one.
 297 439 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Spain 1-3 England 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 Now every Spain supporter is on their feet waving their scarves in the air. 
 They are rocking and are desperate to get behind their team. England just need to stay disciplined here.
